Container.Name: MeshCentral
Container.Overview:
MeshCentral is a free, open-source, self-hosted remote management server. Through a small agent you get remote desktop, terminal, file transfer and power control for Windows, Linux and macOS devices, all in the browser. Uses the official image ghcr.io/ylianst/meshcentral.
Before the first start: set Server name (HOSTNAME) to the DNS name or IP that agents and browsers use. Keep the HTTPS host port, its container port and PORT the same number: MeshCentral tells the agents to connect to the port it listens on.
Then open https://[server]:8443. The first account you create becomes the administrator.
DYNAMIC_CONFIG=true writes the values of this template into config.json at every start. Set it to false if you prefer to edit appdata/meshcentral/data/config.json by hand.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: remote desktop rmm agent management support teamviewer anydesk rustdesk intel amt
Container.Requires: Set Server name (HOSTNAME) before the first start. It is built into every agent installer.

Config.Name: HTTPS port
Config.Description: Web UI and agent connections. Host port, container port and PORT must be the same number.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Plain HTTP, redirects to HTTPS. Any free host port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: config.json, certificates and the built-in database. Back this up.

Config.Name: Files
Config.Description: Files stored on the server through the web UI.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Server backups (when autoBackup is enabled in config.json).

Config.Name: Web
Config.Description: Custom web pages and themes. Can stay empty.

Config.Name: Server name (HOSTNAME)
Config.Description: DNS name or IP that agents and browsers use to reach this server, e.g. mesh.example.com. Used for the server certificate and built into every agent installer.

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port MeshCentral listens on and tells the agents. Must match the HTTPS port above.

Config.Name: DYNAMIC_CONFIG
Config.Description: true: write the values of this template into config.json at every start. false: config.json is only created once and then left alone.

Config.Name: ALLOW_NEW_ACCOUNTS
Config.Description: Let anyone create an account on the login page. The first account is always allowed and becomes the administrator.

Config.Name: WEBRTC
Config.Description: Use WebRTC for direct connections between browser and agent.

Config.Name: ALLOW_PLUGINS
Config.Description: Enable MeshCentral plugins.

Config.Name: IFRAME
Config.Description: Allow the web UI to be embedded in an iframe.

Config.Name: MINIFY
Config.Description: Serve minified web pages.

Config.Name: LOCAL_SESSION_RECORDING
Config.Description: Allow recording of remote sessions.

Config.Name: REVERSE_PROXY
Config.Description: Public name of a reverse proxy in front of MeshCentral, e.g. mesh.example.com. MeshCentral loads the proxy certificate from there so agents trust it. See the README.

Config.Name: REVERSE_PROXY_TLS_PORT
Config.Description: HTTPS port of the reverse proxy.

Config.Name: TLS_OFFLOAD
Config.Description: IP of the reverse proxy when it terminates TLS and talks plain HTTP to MeshCentral. Leave EMPTY otherwise: any value, even false, switches TLS off.

Config.Name: TRUSTED_PROXY
Config.Description: Trust X-Forwarded-For from: all, or one IP in double quotes, e.g. "172.17.0.1".

Config.Name: INSTALL_STYLISHUI
Config.Description: Download and install the third-party Stylish UI theme at every start.

Config.Name: USE_MONGODB
Config.Description: Use MongoDB instead of the built-in database (recommended for many devices).

Config.Name: MONGO_URL
Config.Description: e.g. mongodb://user:password@192.168.1.10:27017/meshcentral

Config.Name: USE_MARIADB
Config.Description: Use MariaDB/MySQL instead of the built-in database.

Config.Name: MARIADB_HOST
Config.Description: MariaDB server name or IP.

Config.Name: MARIADB_PORT
Config.Description: MariaDB port.

Config.Name: MARIADB_USER
Config.Description: MariaDB user.

Config.Name: MARIADB_PASS
Config.Description: MariaDB password.

Config.Name: MARIADB_DATABASE
Config.Description: MariaDB database name.

Config.Name: USE_POSTGRESQL
Config.Description: Use PostgreSQL instead of the built-in database.

Config.Name: PSQL_HOST
Config.Description: PostgreSQL server name or IP.

Config.Name: PSQL_PORT
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port.

Config.Name: PSQL_USER
Config.Description: PostgreSQL user.

Config.Name: PSQL_PASS
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password.

Config.Name: PSQL_DATABASE
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name.
